description: This source file defines the class GenericDateDisplayField, part of the OrangeHRM project. It manages the display of date-related fields in reports, mapping field aliases to entity attributes, and provides methods for setting and retrieving entity and field information.

classes.name: GenericDateDisplayField
classes.description: A class representing a specific date display field used in reporting, capable of mapping field aliases to entity attributes and providing relevant metadata.

methods.name: setDisplayField
methods.description: Sets the entity alias and field based on the provided display field's alias.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array containing the entity alias used in the display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array containing the field name used in the display field.
